claim: Royal Ascot 2026 runs 16-20 June with Windsor Enclosure tickets from £37, Queen Anne from £99 and a members-only Royal Enclosure.
quote: Windsor Enclosure (from £37): A casual option with 'no formal Dress Code' and the ability to bring your own picnic; Queen Anne Enclosure (from £99); Royal Enclosure: Exclusive to members.

claim: Royal Ascot's Royal Enclosure dress code requires hats/headpieces with a 10cm base, no strapless or off-the-shoulder dresses, and skirts not far above the knee.
quote: Headwear must be worn (a hat or headpiece with a base of 4 inches/10cm), dresses and skirts must not go much further above the knee, midriffs should not be on show, and strapless/off-the-shoulder outfits are not permitted.

claim: The Royal Windsor Horse Show 2026 takes place 14-17 May in the private Home Park beside Windsor Castle, with general entry from £28.
quote: Royal Windsor Horse Show is taking place from Thursday 14th to Sunday 17th May 2026. General entry starts from £28, family tickets from £25, and group tickets (10+) from £23.

claim: Henley Royal Regatta 2026 runs Tuesday 30 June to Sunday 5 July, with over 400 races and a public Regatta Enclosure plus the members-only Stewards' Enclosure.
quote: The event runs Tuesday, 30 June - Sunday, 5 July 2026 ... over 400 races of an international standard, which can include Olympic rowers, as well as crews new to the event.

claim: Henley Royal Regatta's Stewards' Enclosure enforces formal daywear — jackets and ties for men, formal dresses for women — while the Regatta Enclosure is unofficially blazers and summer dresses.
quote: The Stewards' Enclosure and some hospitality spaces expect formal daywear (jackets and ties for men; formal dresses or equivalent for women). Regatta Enclosure: There is no official dress code, although attendees tend to follow a similar pattern. Think summer dresses, blazers, and chinos.

claim: Henley Festival 2026 runs Wednesday 8 to Sunday 12 July on the Regatta site, with a 2026 lineup including Boy George & Culture Club, Sugababes, Ezra Collective and Lulu.
quote: Henley Festival | Wednesday 8th to Sunday 12th July 2026

claim: The Cartier Queen's Cup at Guards Polo Club, Smith's Lawn in Windsor Great Park, holds its semi-finals on Wednesday 10 June and the final on Sunday 14 June 2026.
quote: The Cartier Queen's Cup will be held on the Semi-Finals on Wednesday June 10, and the Final on Sunday, June 14, 2026 ... the jewel in the crown of English polo.

claim: HPA International Day for the Royal Salute Coronation Cup is on Saturday 25 July 2026 at Guards Polo Club, with England defending the cup against an international team.
quote: HPA's International Day will take place on Saturday, 25th July 2026 at Guards Polo Club ... England squad will be at their peak in a bid to retain the mighty Coronation Cup.

claim: Royal County of Berkshire Polo Club's 2026 highlights include the Justerini & Brooks Prince of Wales Trophy final on 16 May and the John Prestwich final on 13 June, with most matches free to walk up to.
quote: The Justerini & Brooks Prince of Wales Trophy Final is scheduled for Saturday, May 16, 2026 ... The John Prestwich Final of the 10-12 Goal Tournament is scheduled for Saturday, June 13.

claim: The Royal Windsor Triathlon's 35th edition is on Sunday 14 June 2026 from Alexandra Gardens, offering Sprint, Standard and Relay options, with Standard race entry £99-£121.
quote: The Royal Windsor Triathlon takes place on Sunday 14 June 2026 at Alexandra Gardens, Windsor SL4 1RF ... Sprint Triathlon costs Early Bird £81, Standard £90, or Last Minute £99, while Standard Triathlon costs Early Bird £99, Standard £110, or Last Minute £121.

claim: Cookham Regatta 2026 is on Saturday 5 September on the Thames at Cookham, with dragon-boat races, classic-car displays, a dog show and a funfair, run as a Rotary charity fundraiser.
quote: Saturday, September 5th, 2026 ... Dragon boat races, Classic car displays, Dog show ... annual charity fundraiser where proceeds will be donated to a number of charities.

claim: Marlow Town Regatta & Festival 2026 takes place over the weekend of Saturday 13 and Sunday 14 June on the Thames at Marlow, about 12 km from Bray.
quote: The Marlow Town Regatta 2026 will be held on Saturday 13th June. The regatta runs on Saturday 13th and Sunday 14th June 2026.

claim: Maidenhead Festival 2026 is a free year-round community programme — Battle of the Choirs (18 July), Live & Local Summer Sounds (22 August), Battle of the Bands (19 September) — rather than a single carnival day.
quote: Battle of the Choirs: July 18, 2026; Live and Local: Summer Sounds: August 22, 2026; Battle of the Bands: September 19, 2026 ... All festival events are free to attend.

claim: Ascot is about 12.4 km from Bray and Windsor about 10 km, putting all the headline royal Berkshire events well inside a 30 km day-trip radius.
quote: The estimated driving distance from Ascot to Bray is 7.69 miles or 12.38 km ... The driving distance between Windsor to Bray, Berkshire is 6 miles.

claim: Newbury Racecourse sits roughly 56 km (35 miles) west of Bray, putting it beyond the 30 km radius despite being a well-known Berkshire flat- and jumps-racing venue.
quote: Bray is approximately 35 miles away from Newbury Racecourse.
